messages:
maya: Noticed many SDK users get a bare 'stream closed' error when streaming responses. No typed info so apps can't distinguish resumable vs terminal failures.

sam: Is this happening on hosted-only? Example log?

maya: Hosted. We saw connection reset followed by truncated chunks. Current server blob is something like: {type: 'stream_interruption', http_status: 499, message: 'connection reset'} and SDK throws generic IOError.

leo: 499 is tricky. Suggest we standardize a small error envelope for streaming: typed_code, resumable, resume_cursor, retry_after_seconds, hint.

shreya: Minimal proposal: typed_code in [StreamInterrupted, AuthFailure, RateLimited, InternalTransient], resumable bool, optional resume_cursor, retry_after_seconds, and short human hint. Example stringified payload: {typed_code: 'StreamInterrupted', http_status: 499, resumable: true, resume_cursor: 'tok_1234', retry_after_seconds: 2, hint: 'Transient network blip — resume with resume_cursor or retry.'}

manuel: Resume only if runtime supports prefix replay. If resumable=false SDK should expose a distinct typed exception to prevent naive retries.

maya: SDK action: add StreamInterruptedError with properties {resumable, retry_after, resume_cursor, hint}, plus helpers isRetryable(err) and suggestedBackoff(err). JS example: try { for await (const c of client.responses.stream(...)) {} } catch (err) { if (err instanceof StreamInterruptedError) { if (err.resumable) client.responses.resume(err.resume_cursor); else if (isRetryable(err)) await sleep(suggestedBackoff(err)); else throw err } else throw err }

leo: For Go, implement errors.Is and provide errutil.SuggestedBackoff. Also map HTTP codes: 401/403->AuthFailure, 429->RateLimited (include retry_after_seconds), 5xx->InternalTransient (include request_id).

maya: I'll add a streaming-resume-tester sample-app (proxy that drops TCP after N tokens) and a README showing best-practice handling.

ci-bot: test-runner queued: sample-apps/streaming-resume-tester integration.

sam: Docs/UI: show concise hint + resumable icon + copyable snippet. Suggested one-line user copy: 'Partial response due to transient network error. You can resume the response or retry.'

manuel: Action items: @eng-runtime implement envelope and resume cursor (maya+leo), @devex update SDKs to surface typed exceptions (sam+shreya), @samples add tester (maya), @docs add snippet (shreya).

maya: Filing meta-ticket and opening PRs tonight. Will include unit test asserting err.resumable !== undefined for simulated drops.

ci-bot: created issue RW-4567: standardize streaming error envelope and SDK typed exceptions (assigned maya).
